RowKey.name: row_key
RowKey.description: Unpadded RFC 4648 base64url encoding of the scalar primary key

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The exact strong ETag returned by the current resource representation. Missing, malformed, wildcard, and weak validators have distinct outcomes defined by x-pane-etag.

schema.description: Any transport-valid header value is accepted. A valid UUID is echoed; every other value is ignored and replaced with a generated UUID.

OriginRequired.name: Origin
OriginRequired.description: Browser-controlled serialized origin preserved by the trusted proxy. Before authentication it resolves the application; after server-side session binding it may only be compared with the session application and never selects a different application.

OriginOptional.name: Origin
OriginOptional.description: Validated against the immutable server-session application when supplied. Its absence on a same-origin read is allowed and never changes application context.

TrustedOrigin.description: Canonical stored serialized origin with lowercase scheme/host and no default port, credentials, path, query, or fragment.

RedirectUri.description: Canonical stored redirect with lowercase scheme/host, no default port, a non-empty slash-prefixed path, and no credentials or fragment.

TrustedOriginInput.description: Registration input normalized before storage. It contains only scheme, host, and optional port; HTTP is limited to loopback local/test registrations.

RedirectUriInput.description: Registration or login input normalized before comparison. Credentials and fragments are forbidden; HTTP is limited to loopback local/test registrations.

OriginTransport.description: Raw transport header inspected by application-resolution middleware before OpenAPI parameter validation. It is never used directly as an application identifier.

StrongEtag.description: Quoted strong opaque validator. Weak validators and wildcard preconditions are forbidden in v1.

ETag.description: Strong validator for the returned mutable resource representation.
